theorem_title: Complete classification of the three-occurrence Horn formulas of $d$-regular graphs for all $d\ge1$
natural_language_statement: Let $H$ be a simple $d$-regular graph with $n$ vertices and $m=dn/2$ edges, with a port labelling, and let $T_H$ be the three-occurrence Horn formula with $d+1$ clones at every vertex. (1) For $d\ge1$, the maximum number of satisfied clauses is $(d+1)n+m+\alpha(H)$, $2m=dn$ and $2\alpha(H)\le n$. (2) Every assignment $z$ is repaired to an independent set $R(z)$ with $\mathrm{score}(z)\le(d+1)n+m+|R(z)|$. (3) The assignment of an independent set $I$ (clones of vertices of $I$ false, all others true) satisfies exactly $(d+1)n+m+|I|$ clauses. (4) The all-true assignment satisfies at least $\frac{3d+2}{3d+3}$ of the optimum for every $d\ge1$, and at least $\frac{83}{84}$ for $d\ge27$. (5) If $6\alpha\le7|I|$ the lift of $I$ satisfies at least $\frac{21d+20}{21d+21}$ of the optimum, for every $d\ge1$. (6) If $27\alpha\le28|I|+d\alpha$ the lift satisfies at least $\frac{83}{84}$ of the optimum, for every $d\ge1$. (7) If $d\ge22$ and $5\alpha\le(d+3)|I|$ the lift satisfies at least $\frac{83}{84}$ of the optimum; for every degree $e+2$ and $\varepsilon=1/c$ the division-free form of the ratio $1-\frac{d-2+\varepsilon}{(3d+3)(d+3+\varepsilon)}$ holds. (8) For $d=21$, an independent set satisfying $50\alpha\le241|I|$ when $200\alpha\le99n$ and $3n\le25|I|$ when $99n<200\alpha$ has a lift of ratio at least $\frac{83}{84}$. (9) For $d=1$, $\alpha(H)=m=n/2$ and the optimum is $3n$; for $d=2$, $m=n$ and the optimum is $4n+\alpha(H)$. The polynomial running times, the exact computation of a maximum independent set on paths and cycles, and the Berman--Fujito, Trevisan and Goemans--Williamson guarantees are not formalized.
explanation: Item (1) is `DegreeFormula.optimum_identity_proof`, `two_mul_edges_eq` and `independence_number_le_half`: the number of satisfied clauses splits as $U(z)+(m-F(z))+((d+1)n-T(z))$ (`satCount_eq_score_proof`), the cycle lemma and the deletion of one endpoint of every edge between clean vertices give the repair of item (2) (`repairedSet_independent_proof`, `repairedSet_card_lower_bound_proof`), and the lift of item (3) is `lift_satCount`. Items (4) to (8) are `baseline_ratio`, `baseline_ratio_83_84`, `lift_ratio_from_mis`, `lift_ratio_threshold`, `lift_ratio_bf`, `lift_ratio_degree_21` and `lift_ratio_bf_general`, which reduce to linear arithmetic from $2m=dn$ and $2\alpha\le n$ (`DegreeTransfer`). Item (9) is `RegularLemmas.alpha_deg_one` (the left endpoints of the edges form an independent set of size $m$ when every vertex has one port), `opt_deg_one` and `opt_deg_two`. This submission is supported by a Lean 4 formalization, available at https://github.com/frankvegadelgado/paloma. The formalization covers the exact optimum identities, the repair and lifting steps, and the arithmetic of the approximation ratios. The Berman–Fujito, Trevisan and Goemans–Williamson guarantees are taken from the literature and are stated as explicit hypotheses.
definition_title: Formula $T_H$ of a $d$-regular port graph, its independent sets and satisfied clauses
definition_nl: Formal model of the three-occurrence Horn formula $T_H$ of a $d$-regular graph with a port labelling (`PortGraph`), with $d+1$ clones per vertex, its independent sets and independence number (`Independent`, `IsIndependenceNumber`), the repaired set of an assignment (`repairedSet`), its score and the number of satisfied clauses (`score`, `satCount`), and the assignment of an independent set (`assignmentOfIndependent`).
